rules.text: The city is divided into 5 geographic zones for residential arnona (3 for non-residential).
Zone boundaries run along the middle of the street unless stated otherwise.
The zone is set by the address of the main entrance to the building.
The binding map is the one kept at the arnona billing department offices, including the separate exceptions list.
Zones 4 and 5 share one rate column.

size_band_rule.order_text: Table 2.3 columns for zones 1 and 2: "וילות בכל שטח+דירות מעל 140 מ"ר" and "דירות עד 140 מ"ר"; zones 3 and 4-5: "כל סוגי הדירות".
size_band_rule.how_charged: One per-m2 rate for the whole apartment, chosen by the apartment's total area (140 m2 or less vs above 140 m2); villas always take the higher column. The order contains NO clause for a marginal (split-by-band) computation; this whole-area reading follows the table headings and is not confirmed by a city worked example or a real bill.
size_band_rule.boundary: 140 m2 exactly falls in "עד 140"; area is first rounded per 1.3.1.א (half a m2 rounds down).

area_rules.rule: Area unit is 1 m2; each part of a m2 is rounded to the nearest whole m2; half a m2 is rounded down.
All area inside the building unit, including a gallery (יציע) and any other covered area, plus balconies (מרפסות), sheds (סככות) and swimming pools.
Included in the area at the full rate (1.3.1.ב "וכן מרפסות"). Garden balcony (מרפסת גן): charged in full if covered, or if it has a railing or wall on three sides of its perimeter.
Charged in full if it has two walls or more.
Exterior and interior walls are not included.
Covered or uncovered area used only for parking, in a building used for residence, is not included in the unit area.

A paved roof in a residential building serving one apartment only, with access from that apartment, is included at up to 30% of the area of the apartment below the roof (or of the level under the roof in a multi-level apartment), excluding balconies.

Common area in a mostly residential building with two or more holders is not charged, except areas used for a swimming pool, game rooms etc., and common areas in an apartment hotel (those are charged at the residential rate per 2.3 note 2).
Swimming pools are in the building area (1.3.1.ב); private pools are charged at the residential rate (2.3 note 1).

NOT FOUND: the order has no clause on a storage room (מחסן) attached to an apartment. Section 3.3.2 "מחסנים" is a non-residential use. Whether a residential storage room is billed, and at which rate, is not stated.

discounts.legal_basis: תקנות הסדרים במשק המדינה (הנחה מארנונה), התשנ"ג-1993 (order 6 intro); statutory discounts from other laws (e.g. Senior Citizens Law 1989; Local Authorities (Exemption of Soldiers, War Casualties and Police from Arnona) Law 1953) are listed on the city page, not in the order.

general_rules.rule: Only one personal discount: the highest one (במקרה של זכאות ליותר מהנחה אחת, תינתן הנחה אחת בלבד – הגבוהה מביניהן).
A holder of two or more properties gets a discount on one property only.
Pro rata to the months held in the fiscal year.
The full arnona for the year must be paid by 31.12, otherwise the discount is cancelled.
Applicant must be registered as the holder; if registered in another authority's population register, a certificate that no discount is given there.

Order discounts (except 6(17) and 6(1)(ג)) apply only to a holder of a dwelling used only for residence. The order lists only the council-discretion discounts; mandatory statutory discounts are not in it.

Discount computation for a calculator: discount_ils = rate_pct/100 x (zone/type rate per m2) x min(area, area_cap_m2) [cap null = whole area]. This formula is the calculator's reading of "X% לגבי Y מ"ר משטח הנכס"; the order gives no worked example.

items.conditions: Order 6(7). City page: whole area.

items.name_he: איש צד"ל
items.name_en: South Lebanon Army veteran

items.conditions: Order 6(8).

items.name_he: זכאי לגמלה להבטחת הכנסה / תשלום לפי חוק המזונות / גימלת סיעוד
items.name_en: Recipient of income support, alimony payment (guarantee law) or long-term-care benefit

items.name_he: בעל הכנסה חודשית ממוצעת (לפי מספר נפשות)

items.conditions: Order 6(10)(ב): "income" = gross income of the holder and those living with him (incl. a foster child) from every source, including NII payments, EXCEPT (1) benefits under NII Law chapters ד' and י"א and the disabled-child benefit (2010 regulations); (2) half of the monthly income of a son/daughter living with the holder, and for one son/daughter only, income up to the minimum wage is not counted (minimum wage on 1.1.2026: 6,247.67 ILS per the city page); (3) rent received, up to the rent the holder pays for another home he rents to live in; (4) reserve-duty special/additional pay. "Average monthly income": employee = average monthly income in 2025; self-employed = last annual income-tax assessment /12, indexed to the Oct-Dec 2025 CPI average (order printed p.30). City page: the discount applies to the whole apartment area.

income_table_gross_monthly_ils.note: Upper bound of each band, inclusive ("עד"); the next band starts "above" the previous bound. Households of 10+ use per-person bounds.

bi_monthly.condition: each instalment paid on its date
bi_monthly.cpi_linkage: each instalment carries linkage differences (Local Authorities (Interest and Linkage Differences on Mandatory Payments) Law 1980) by the CPI change from the October 2025 index (published 15 November 2025) to the index published just before the payment date

new_holder_after_1_jan.rule: charged with linkage differences as above

default.rule: failure to pay two instalments on time lets the city demand the whole annual charge, with interest and linkage counted from 1 January 2026

city_page_practice.one_advance_payment: pay the whole sum by 31 January: no linkage differences accrue during the year (except charges approved later)
city_page_practice.periodic: 6 bi-monthly CPI-linked payments; each voucher states its last day, always by the end of an odd month
city_page_practice.bank_standing_order: six bi-monthly debits on the 3rd of each even month
city_page_practice.late_payment: monthly interest 0.5% (or another rate set) plus linkage differences to the payment day

payment.annual_prepayment_discount_note: No percentage discount for paying the year in advance is published for the general public in the 2026 order or on the payments page; the only advance-payment discount is 2% for senior citizens aged 75+ paying in January 2026 (order 6(1)(ג)).

not_found_or_not_covered: A marginal (split-by-band) method: no such clause; the order sets one rate per apartment class (<=140 m2 / >140 m2).
Storage room (מחסן) attached to an apartment: no residential clause in the order.
A separate student discount: none; the city refers students to the low-income test.
A general % discount for paying the year in advance: not published (only 2% for seniors 75+).
Address -> zone lookup inside the order: not provided (raster map); the city GIS layer 589 can do it but is labelled with the 2025 order date.
The consolidated official text of the 1993 discount regulations: not retrieved from an official site in this pass; the discount values above come from the TLV order and the TLV city pages.
The guard levy (היטל שמירה): a separate municipal charge, not part of arnona; not researched here.
Kikar HaMedina towers' completion year / billing class: not in the order.
